description: This is a CMake module file that provides functions for setting up code coverage analysis in CMake projects, including configuring coverage tools like gcov, gcovr, and lcov, and creating build targets for coverage reports.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_lcov
methods.description: Defines a build target for collecting code coverage with lcov and generating an HTML report.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_xml
methods.description: Defines a build target that runs gcovr to produce an XML coverage report in Cobertura format.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_html
methods.description: Defines a build target that runs gcovr to generate an HTML coverage report.

methods.name: append_coverage_compiler_flags
methods.description: Appends coverage-related compiler flags to the current CMake configuration.
